verdict.rationale:
Databricks Genie is documented specifically as a natural-language Q&A tool for business users grounded in organizational data (docs-8, docs-57, docs-80), backed by Unity Catalog governance enforced on every query (docs-19, docs-38, docs-94) and metric views that define a business metric once so answers use consistent, correct computations rather than ad hoc joins (docs-7, docs-16, docs-72). Marketing copy also frames this as 'BI built on AI from the start' with conversational analytics (docs-22).
Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence validating Genie's accuracy or hallucination-avoidance in practice, and no community corroboration specifically about Genie's semantic grounding (only generic platform complaints exist).
